rule_notes: NIKL MCFAQ directly confirms the particle phrase 삶의 as [살믜] and also permits [살메] under Standard Pronunciation Rule §5. Candidate broad surface IPA renders [살믜] as sal.mi, consistent with the post-consonantal ㅢ-to-[i] reading; this remains project-derived pending independent review. The alternate [살메] is rendered sal.me. NIKL does not supply IPA. Ukrainian target remains provisional.
variant_note: Direct NIKL alternatives: 삶의[살믜]/[살메]; particle 의 may be [ㅢ] or [ㅔ].
